name: Cedar vs Candid Health
title: Cedar vs Candid Health: Patient Payments vs AI Claims Automation
description: Compare Cedar (patient financial engagement, $10B+ processed) vs Candid Health (AI claims autocorrection, 95-99% NCR). Different RCM focuses for healthcare organizations.

summary.bottom_line: Cedar and Candid Health address different parts of RCM. Cedar focuses on patient financial engagement - digital billing, payment plans, and collections ($10B+ processed, 22% collections lift). Candid Health focuses on payer-side claims - AI autocorrection before submission to prevent denials (95-99% NCR). Many organizations could use both: Candid for claims, Cedar for patient payments.

sections.heading: Different RCM Problems
sections.content: Cedar and Candid Health solve different revenue cycle challenges. Cedar modernizes patient billing - replacing paper statements with digital experiences, enabling payment plans, and using AI to optimize collection timing and communication. Candid Health focuses on the payer side - using AI to identify and correct claim errors before submission, dramatically reducing denials.

sections.heading: AI Applications
sections.content: Cedar Intelligence uses AI for personalized patient outreach - optimizing timing, channel, tone, and resolution options. Their AI voice agent engages difficult-to-reach patients. Candid Health's AI learns payer-specific requirements and automatically corrects claims before submission, preventing denials rather than managing them after the fact.

sections.heading: Economic Models
sections.content: Cedar uses enterprise custom pricing negotiated with health systems - not publicly disclosed. Candid Health uses a percentage-of-collections model (typically 3-6%) that aligns incentives - they earn more when you collect more. This makes Candid accessible without upfront costs while Cedar requires enterprise contracts.

recommendations.when: Your challenge is patient collections - getting patients to pay after insurance. You need digital billing and payment plans.
Your challenge is claim denials and manual RCM work. You want AI to prevent problems before they happen.
You're a health system wanting end-to-end optimization - Candid for claims, Cedar for patient payments.
You're a growing practice wanting scalable RCM without enterprise contracts.

faqs.q: Can I use Cedar and Candid Health together?
faqs.a: Yes. They address different parts of revenue cycle. Candid Health optimizes claims (payer side) while Cedar optimizes patient collections (patient side). Many health systems could benefit from both.

faqs.q: What is Candid Health's claims autocorrection?
faqs.a: Candid's AI identifies coding errors, missing information, and payer-specific requirements before claims are submitted, fixing problems proactively to prevent denials rather than managing them after.

Cedar Intelligence is Cedar's AI platform that personalizes patient outreach - determining optimal timing, channel (email, text, call), tone, and resolution options. It includes an AI voice agent for engaging hard-to-reach patients.

faqs.q: Which is better for small practices?
faqs.a: Candid Health. Its percentage-of-collections pricing (3-6%) requires no upfront investment. Cedar is designed for larger health systems with enterprise contracts.
